title: Uruguayan-Style Crisp Burger
description: A juicy burger with a crispy twist, inspired by Uruguayan flavors. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: 2. Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
3. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, Uruguayan seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
4. Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal parts and shape into patties.
5. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add a few drops of olive oil and cook the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
6. Meanwhile, toast the buns on the pan or in the oven.
7. Assemble the burgers with the cooked patties, crispy potato wedges, and top with crisp.
